name: LogiQA
description: LogiQA is a machine reading comprehension dataset with logical reasoning questions sourced from Chinese Civil Service Examination. Given a context paragraph and a question, models select the correct answer from four options. Questions require various types of logical reasoning including deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning.
reputation: Standard logical reasoning benchmark from real civil service exams; human performance ~86%; widely used to test LLM logical reasoning abilities
notes: Introduced at IJCAI 2020. Contains 8,678 multiple-choice questions (6,521 train, 651 dev, 1,000 test) from National Civil Service Examination of China. Covers deductive, inductive, abductive, and combined reasoning types. LogiQA 2.0 released in 2023 at ACL with expanded scope. Tasks are harder than RACE-style reading comprehension due to explicit reasoning requirements.
